summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of a charter amendment to extend its business combination deadline on a monthly basis from June 14, 2026 up to March 14, 2027, contingent on sponsor deposits of the lesser of $25,000 or $0.02 per outstanding redeemable share per extension. The special meeting held June 11, 2026 saw 99.75% quorum with unanimous votes for. This is a routine SPAC extension filing to maintain the trust vehicle for a potential future de-SPAC transaction; no definitive agreement or business combination terms are disclosed. The filing itself is procedural and does not constitute a special-situation event.
